## Callback types

### `entasis_collision_pair_filter_proc_t`

accepts or rejects one complete collidable pair

```c
typedef entasis_bool_t (ENTASIS_CALL *entasis_collision_pair_filter_proc_t)(void * user_context, entasis_collidable_reference_t a, entasis_collidable_reference_t b);
```

| Parameter      | C type                           | Meaning                                          |
| -------------- | -------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `user_context` | `void *`                         | caller-owned context passed unchanged by Entasis |
| `a`            | `entasis_collidable_reference_t` | collidable reference A                           |
| `b`            | `entasis_collidable_reference_t` | collidable reference B                           |

returns ENTASIS_TRUE to keep the pair or ENTASIS_FALSE to reject it

### `entasis_material_combine_proc_t`

combines two collidable materials into one contact material

```c
typedef entasis_bool_t (ENTASIS_CALL *entasis_material_combine_proc_t)(void * user_context, entasis_material_id_t a_id, const entasis_material_t * a, entasis_material_id_t b_id, const entasis_material_t * b, entasis_material_t * out_material);
```

| Parameter      | C type                       | Meaning                                          |
| -------------- | ---------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `user_context` | `void *`                     | caller-owned context passed unchanged by Entasis |
| `a_id`         | `entasis_material_id_t`      | material ID for collidable A                     |
| `a`            | `const entasis_material_t *` | borrowed material for collidable A               |
| `b_id`         | `entasis_material_id_t`      | material ID for collidable B                     |
| `b`            | `const entasis_material_t *` | borrowed material for collidable B               |
| `out_material` | `entasis_material_t *`       | receives the combined contact material           |

returns ENTASIS_TRUE to use out_material or ENTASIS_FALSE to use the default combination

### `entasis_restitution_combine_fn`

combines settings on the owner thread before workers execute

the callback may edit only out_settings. it must not mutate its world, retain borrowed pointers or unwind across the ABI. invalid output rejects solve preparation

```c
typedef void (ENTASIS_CALL *entasis_restitution_combine_fn)(void * user_context, entasis_collidable_reference_t a, entasis_collidable_reference_t b, const entasis_restitution_settings_t * settings_a, const entasis_restitution_settings_t * settings_b, entasis_restitution_settings_t * out_settings);
```

| Parameter      | C type                                   | Meaning                                                            |
| -------------- | ---------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `user_context` | `void *`                                 | copied configuration context                                       |
| `a`            | `entasis_collidable_reference_t`         | first collidable                                                   |
| `b`            | `entasis_collidable_reference_t`         | second collidable                                                  |
| `settings_a`   | `const entasis_restitution_settings_t *` | effective first settings, callback-local                           |
| `settings_b`   | `const entasis_restitution_settings_t *` | effective second settings, callback-local                          |
| `out_settings` | `entasis_restitution_settings_t *`       | initialized to componentwise maximum. written values are validated |

writes the effective pair settings

### `entasis_material`

constructs one per-collidable material without allocation

```c
ENTASIS_API entasis_material_t ENTASIS_CALL entasis_material(float friction, float maximum_recovery_velocity, entasis_spring_settings_t spring);
```

| --------------------------- | --------------------------- | ------------------------------------- |

returns the material

### `entasis_material_combine_default`

implements a commutative order-independent combination: friction is multiplied, maximum recovery velocity is the larger value, and spring settings come from the material with the larger recovery velocity

ties select the stiffer spring and then the more damped spring. the rule is independent of collidable ordering and worker count

```c
ENTASIS_API entasis_material_t ENTASIS_CALL entasis_material_combine_default(entasis_material_t a, entasis_material_t b);
```

| Parameter | C type               | Meaning    |
| --------- | -------------------- | ---------- |
| `a`       | `entasis_material_t` | material A |
| `b`       | `entasis_material_t` | material B |

returns the default material

### `entasis_world_enable_restitution`

enables optional restitution for accepted solid contacts

velocity is captured after integration and before all warmstart impulses. triggers and rejected pairs do not bounce. zero effective coefficients use ordinary solving. callback user data remains borrowed

```c
ENTASIS_API entasis_status_t ENTASIS_CALL entasis_world_enable_restitution(entasis_world_t * world, const entasis_restitution_configuration_t * configuration, entasis_diagnostic_t * diagnostic);
```

| Parameter       | C type                                        | Meaning                                      |
| --------------- | --------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| `world`         | `entasis_world_t *`                           | idle world outside callbacks and read phases |
| `configuration` | `const entasis_restitution_configuration_t *` | copied configuration. NULL selects defaults  |
| `diagnostic`    | `entasis_diagnostic_t *`                      | optional diagnostic output                   |

returns ENTASIS_STATUS_OK on success or a failure status
